title: Vanguards tuning
description: Gameplay tuning owned by the Vanguards domain (ADR-008 §2, §5): each Vanguard's body, stats, growth, basic attack, kit and passive, keyed by content ID, and each passive archetype's records. VeyraVanguards binds it to FVeyraVanguardsTuning. test_vanguard is the developer test Vanguard, the successor of the M3 developer loadout.

stats.description: Base stats (FVeyraStatBlock): Max Health, Move Speed and Attack Speed above 0, the rest at least 0.

healthRegen.description: Health per second, in and out of combat (Combat Bible §6; ADR-011 §11).

growth.description: What each level after the first adds to the base stats (Economy & Progression Bible §9).

attackSpeedFraction.description: Each level adds this fraction of the level-1 Attack Speed.

shape.description: A hit shape (ADR-009 §4). Each kind uses its own sizes; the others are 0.

homingProjectile.description: A homing projectile, which terrain does not stop (ADR-008 §9).

damage.description: One damage component: the amount plus the owner's power times the ratios (Combat Bible §25).

amountByRank.description: One value: a passive has no ranks.

secondaryImpact.description: An explosion behind a basic attack's target, facing away from the attacker; the target itself is never hit by it (ADR-009 §5).

priority.description: A higher priority replaces a lower one; an attack keeps one impact.

statuses.description: Status IDs from Abilities.json's statuses map.

basicAttack.description: How the Vanguard's basic attacks work (Combat Bible §4, §48; ADR-008 §2).

range.description: Edge to edge, in units (Combat Bible §40).

damageType.description: Physical unless the Vanguard overrides it (Combat Bible §4).

windupFraction.description: The part of each attack's interval before Commit; the rest is backswing.

acquisitionRadius.description: How far past the Vanguard's edge attack-move looks for an enemy.

minimumIntervalSeconds.description: The shortest time between attacks whatever the Attack Speed; 0 for none.

projectile.description: A ranged attack's homing projectile; empty for melee.

cleave.description: Where the attack cleaves when something makes it cleave: at the Vanguard, facing its target.

shield.description: A shield granted to the Vanguard (Combat Bible §7, §51; ADR-009 §3): the amount plus Max Health and Magic Power times the ratios.

amountByRank.description: A passive's shield has one value.

maxAmountMaxHealthRatio.description: The most a merged shield holds, as a fraction of Max Health.

absorbedReward.description: At most one: once a grant of this shield has absorbed this fraction of its amount, its holder gains the statuses once, from its provider (ADR-027 §5).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

vanguards.description: Every Vanguard, keyed by its stable ID (ADR-008 §2).

availability.description: Playable Vanguards are released: players may own and pick them, and the backend's catalog lists them (ADR-010 §6). Developer Vanguards exist for tests and development servers only; a Shipping match server refuses them.

resource.description: What the Vanguard spends to cast (Combat Bible §27). Every family is spent, regenerated and refunded alike; Focus has no growth per level and its own colour on the HUD (ADR-031 §1).

capsuleRadius.description: The body's radius, which ranges measure from (Combat Bible §40).

capsuleHalfHeight.description: Including the rounded ends, so at least the radius.

abilities.description: The ability in each slot, from Abilities.json; R is the ultimate.

rankShape.description: At most one: a rank shape from Progression.json's rankShapes, a documented exception to the standard ranks (ADR-031 §2). None ranks as standard.

passive.description: The passive, from one of the passive maps.

deepFoundation.description: Passives that shield their Vanguard when one of its abilities immobilizes an enemy Vanguard (Cairn's Deep Foundation, Character Bible §18).

shield.description: The shield each immobilized enemy Vanguard grants.

lockoutSeconds.description: How long the same enemy Vanguard cannot grant the shield again.

hitChain.description: Generic passives that build up over the hit chain, consecutive basic attacks on one enemy Vanguard, and fall off when it ends (ADR-008 §5; Qazharr's Sea Dog, Character Bible §13).

status.description: A status from Abilities.json's statuses map, applied again by each attack in the chain: a stacking status gains a stack per hit.

gatheringLight.description: Passives that gather a stack from each damaging cast that hits an enemy Vanguard and, once primed, send a homing fragment with the next (Oriel's Gathering Light, Character Bible §20).

stacksToPrime.description: Stacks that prime it; canon gives three.

fragmentDamage.description: The fragment's damage, prepared when it launches.

breach.description: Passives that, on every Nth consecutive basic attack on the same enemy Vanguard, add damage and an explosion behind the target (Bryn's Breach, Character Bible §19).

hitsToBreach.description: Which consecutive hit breaches; canon gives the third.

bonusDamage.description: Added to the breaching attack's own damage.

impact.description: The explosion behind the target; a higher-priority impact such as Breach Round's replaces it.

markProc.description: Passives whose basic attacks on enemy Vanguards stack a mark from the owner, and spend it primed at its most stacks for proc damage; optionally an empowered first attack out of a Camouflage, and a window after an ability in which each proc sends a bolt (Mimzi's Pocket Hex, Roster Bible §21).

mark.description: From Abilities.json: a Stacking status whose most stacks prime the proc.

procDamagePerLevel.description: Added for each Level past the first.

status.description: The Camouflage the attack comes out of.

windowSeconds.description: How long after it ends the first attack still counts.

haunt.description: Passives that Haunt an enemy Vanguard that damages their owner, once per its own cooldown, and lash it when it damages an ally near the owner instead (Patch's Haunted Attachment, Roster Bible §5).

hauntStatus.description: From Abilities.json's statuses, put on the enemy by the owner; its time is the Haunt's.

perEnemyCooldownSeconds.description: How long before the same enemy can be Haunted again.

allyRadius.description: Units between the owner's centre and the damaged ally's for the spirit to lash out.

statuses.description: From Abilities.json's statuses, put on the lashed enemy.

campReward.description: Passives that reward their owner for helping clear a whole jungle camp, once per clear, and for enemy Vanguard takedowns on their own cooldown (Gorraveth's No Time to Bleed, Roster Bible §23).

healthRatio.description: Of the owner's Max Health, restored.

statuses.description: From Abilities.json's statuses, put on the owner.

takedownCooldownSeconds.description: Seconds between two rewards from takedowns.

momentum.description: Passives that build Momentum by the distance their owner moves itself, its attacks and its casts; at full its slots hold their Redlined forms, and the cast that spends it readies Roadhouse (Raska's Redline, Roster Bible §1).

meter.description: From Abilities.json's statuses: a Stacking Counter whose stacks are Momentum.

unitsPerPoint.description: The units the owner moves itself for each point.

sampleSeconds.description: How often its own movement is counted.

redlined.description: The Redlined forms its slots hold at full.

holdFullStatuses.description: From Abilities.json's statuses: while the owner has any, the meter stays full.

reachStatus.description: From Abilities.json's statuses, held while Roadhouse waits.

unreturned.description: Passives that restore a share of missing Health out of Vanguard combat and give statuses below Health thresholds (Torr's Unreturned, Roster Bible §9; ADR-028 §7).

restoreFractionPerSecond.description: Of missing Health, restored each second out of Vanguard combat.

quarry.description: Passives that keep one enemy marked at a time (Tavi's You're It!, Roster Bible §6; ADR-030 §10): their owner moves faster while closing on the holder, its next basic attack on the holder spends the mark for bonus magic damage and a refund of its basic abilities' remaining cooldowns, and a kill of the holder sends the mark to the nearest enemy Vanguard in reach.

mark.description: From Abilities.json's statuses: the mark its owner's abilities apply.

chaseStatus.description: From Abilities.json's statuses: a MoveSpeed status its owner holds while closing on the holder.

chaseAngleDegrees.description: How far from straight at the holder its owner may be moving and still close on it.

damageAmount.description: The spent mark's magic damage at Level 1.

cooldownRefund.description: Of Q, W and E's remaining cooldowns, refunded as the mark is spent.

jumpRadius.description: How far from the fallen holder the mark jumps.

reclaim.description: Passives whose owner's basic attacks consume its mark on an enemy Vanguard to heal it, once per lockout per target (Silt's Reclaim, Roster Bible §3; ADR-028 §4).

mark.description: From Abilities.json's statuses: the mark its owner's damaging abilities apply.

lockoutSeconds.description: Seconds before the same target can be reclaimed from again.

slipstream.description: Passives that leave a short current from their owner toward each allied Vanguard its ally-targeted buffs name, speeding the allies inside (Aurelisse's Slipstream, Roster Bible §24; ADR-027 §7).

maxLength.description: The longest current, from the owner toward the ally.

statuses.description: From Abilities.json's statuses: given the owner and the allied Vanguards inside at each pulse; each outlasts a pulse.

attackStride.description: Passives that let their owner walk through a basic attack's windup at a share of its speed, and give it statuses for each primary basic attack that lands on an enemy Vanguard (Celandrine's Never Break Stride, Roster Bible §22; ADR-027 §1, §8).

windupShare.description: The share of Movement Speed kept while a basic attack winds up.

hitStatuses.description: From Abilities.json's statuses: given the owner by each primary basic attack that lands on an enemy Vanguard.

kitStatuses.description: Passives made wholly of the statuses their kit applies and the reactions to them, which run nothing of their own (Korruk's Embedded, Roster Bible §8; ADR-026 §1–§2).

statuses.description: From Abilities.json's statuses: those the passive consists of.

wildDominion.description: Passives that hold statuses while their owner stands on jungle terrain, given again at each check, and restore a share of the Health their damage takes from wildlife (Moro's Wild Dominion, Roster Bible §12; ADR-026 §5).

statuses.description: From Abilities.json's statuses, put on the owner at each check it stands in the jungle; each outlasts a check.

wildlifeHealFraction.description: Of the Health its damage takes from wildlife, the share restored to the owner.

cadence.description: Passives that stack Attack Speed from basic attacks, decaying a stack at a time, echo each attack at full stacks, and hold full while an ultimate lasts, firing a rank every Nth attack (Vera's Cadence, Roster Bible §7).

status.description: From Abilities.json: a Stacking Attack Speed status that decays a stack at a time.

extraStackOn.description: An attack on a target with this status from the owner adds a second stack.

steadyStatus.description: While the owner has it, stacks decay more slowly.

fullStatus.description: While the owner has it, Cadence is full and cannot fall.

damage.description: The echo's type, and an amount and ratios added: proc damage, no On-Hit.

movingTarget.description: Passives that Track enemy Vanguards their owner or an ally displaces, for range and bonus damage against them, and bank the displacement toward an empowered attack (Kade's Moving Target and Dead Reckoning, Roster Bible §2).

trackedStatus.description: From Abilities.json's statuses, applied by the owner: a source-relative range.

trackedDamage.description: Added to the owner's attacks on a target it has Tracked.

thresholdUnits.description: Units of displacement banked before the next attack on a Tracked target spends them.

physicalPowerRatioPerStep.description: Physical Power ratio added for each stepUnits banked.

stepUnits.description: The units each step of the ratio counts (Roster Bible §2: per 100 units).

disciplines.description: Passives of two disciplines whose abilities mark enemy Vanguards for the other to spend (Angeru's No Master, Roster Bible §15; ADR-031 §10). When an ability in a mark's consumedBy hits an enemy Vanguard holding the mark from the owner, the mark goes; an extra strike lands (damageAmount + damagePerLevel per Level after the first + physicalPowerRatio of Physical Power, ignoring penetration of the resistance its type meets), scaled by the ability's bonus damageMultiplier; resourceRefund of the ability's cost comes back; the owner takes casterStatuses; the bonus cooldownRefund of the ability's own remaining cooldown is refunded; and the ability in refundSlot has refundSeconds taken off its remaining cooldown.
